definitionZh: 使用@page at-rule的首个 CSS 假类代表打印文档的首页 。 (一个节点的一般第一元素,见:第一子.
sourceDefinition: The :first CSS pseudo-class, used with the @page at-rule, represents the first page of a printed document. (See :first-child for general first element of a node.)
